build_audio_classification_model: build an AudioClassificationModel from a pretrained wav2vec checkpoint for audio classification
run_audio_classification_forward: run forward pass on audio source tensors through the audio classification model
create_audio_classification_config: create an AudioClassificationConfig dataclass with dropout masking and prediction mode settings
compute_audio_gain_numpy: compute A-weighted or RMSE gain in decibels from a numpy audio signal
compute_audio_gain_torch: compute A-weighted or RMSE gain in decibels from a torch audio tensor
